prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1483; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- A dated inspection photo shows the same dent before this crash.
text: The vehicle presents front-end damage consistent with the reported low-speed head-on impact, including the bumper cover, grille, hood leading edge and the radiator support bracket. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and grille, straightening the hood edge, and refinishing the affected panels. Labor hours are in line with the damage shown. Billing lines were reviewed and no charges appear more than once. An inspection photo on file shows a dent in the same area before this loss, so the prior damage will be separated out from the current repair scope before the estimate is finalized.
